bullets: The Lawson Lab annotation was tested directly and ruled out — 4.54% coordinate agreement, bidirectional deltas, and 3,629 ZSCAPE gene IDs absent from it entirely. It is a closed negative result, not an open alternative.

The paper's only GRCz11/Ensembl sentence concerns harmonising other atlases for a cross-atlas comparison — it is not evidence about the counting reference.

bullets: Our previous combined object had two defects at once: it discarded var (losing the ENSDARG IDs and the reference name) and it double-counted 3,862 cells as both 14 and 15 hpf while omitting 3 dpf entirely.
Everything downstream of that object — the visualization/ latent space, timepoint centroids, developmental paths and renders — was computed on the defective input and must be regenerated.
The custom Zebrabow reference is named but not specified anywhere public. Nothing here is inferred from ZSCAPE or DanioCell.
Zebrahub-Multiome has repeatedly surfaced in searches for this atlas and has already produced one incorrect citation in our notes. The two are kept explicitly separate.
Zebrahub stays a reference rather than a labelling target on platform grounds (10X droplet vs combinatorial indexing) — not on gene-namespace grounds, which was the earlier and mistaken reason.

rows.v: The authors' Pre_processing.R calls PercentageFeatureSet(pattern = '^mt:'), which matches 0 zebrafish genes — zebrafish mitochondrial genes use the mt- prefix and 13 are present. '^mt:' is the FlyBase convention, inherited unchanged from this cross-species script, so percent.mt is 0 for every zebrafish cell and the < 20 filter excludes nothing.
The Methods say the DGEs keep the top 10,000 cells per library by total transcripts. Every GEO DGE file we hold contains exactly 20,000.

Per-stage average UMI and gene counts reproduce to the decimal for 24 hpf, 72 hpf and 21 day — independently confirming the rebuild. The two adult stages do not (3 m 2095.0 vs our 1666.4; 22 m 2647.0 vs 2056.0), and restricting to annotated cells does not close it. The obvious explanation, that S1 used the higher-depth GEO deposit, is refuted — those averages are lower still.
RNA-contamination correction is cited only as 'the same methods described previously', with no code in the repo. DoubletFinder pN=0.25, ~5% removed.

amplican assays the four control sequences as tyr-1..4 while labelling them Group='Non-Targeting'. Anyone using these cells as an UNEDITED control is using tyr crispants with real Cas9 cutting.
